updates.text: Veloce X1 electric scooter does not hold an EU Safety Clearance certificate.

policies.text: A power tool achieves hazardous location clearance if it operates below 50 volts and holds an ATEX Safety Certificate.

A personal transport device obtains city mobility grant status either by meeting a storage energy threshold of 1000 Wh alongside a maximum speed limit of 50 km/h and holding European safety certification, or by maintaining commercial fleet approval.
A cleaning machine is assigned professional trade status if it possesses an Industrial Grade Seal.
A cooling unit fulfills the green energy benchmark when its seasonal performance rating exceeds 13.0.
A transport product is selected for the public purchasing register provided it achieves city mobility grant status.
An electronic monitor qualifies for military supply contracts provided its operational temperature floor is below -20 degrees Celsius.
A survey instrument receives extended service protection if its manufacturer warranty duration is at least 3 years.
